entities.name: Husseiniya Mosque, Ganja
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Huseyniyyah Mosque, also known as the Tat Mosque, is a former mosque and historical architectural monument, located in the city of Ganja, Azerbaijan. The former mosque was completed in 1825 in the Arran School of Architecture style.
